Searching for a chiropractor near Horsham / Warrington PA? Learn what a chiropractor does and how an adjustment can improve your overall health...not just fix your back pain or neck pain.

Our Mission...
Genesis Chiropractic Clinic is committed to providing services to the community to assist them to expand their vision of health and wellness, and to help them achieve those visions, empowering them to be more productive members of society. 
Additionally, our clinic places a high emphasis on educating our patients on the cause of disease and dysfunctions related to the body and on prevention.

Our Philosophy...
It's hard to have a happy life without a healthy body!
A properly functioning body will have a powerful ability to heal itself, and we strive to work with, not against it - so that you can achieve optimal health.
